assumptions.statement: The corridor remains controlled during evaluation.

algorithm_plan.choice: global route planning with local clearance-aware tracking
algorithm_plan.rationale: Separates fixed route intent from short-horizon clearance response.
algorithm_plan.failure_behavior: stop when route clearance cannot be established

hardware_functional_plan.degradation: reduce speed or stop on insufficient freshness

safety_plan.control_authority: all motion flows through one safety gate
safety_plan.stop_behavior: stale or unsafe requests resolve to zero motion
safety_plan.watchdog: motion expires without a fresh bounded request

verification_plan.unit: check clearance limits and request expiry
verification_plan.integration: use fake motion and observation transports
verification_plan.manual_safety_review: approve trial procedure before hardware output

open_decisions: Measure route clearance before physical trials.
